dict.string: macrec records the microphone alongside system audio. Audio is written only to the file path you pass via --output. Nothing is sent over the network.
macrec uses the Screen Recording permission to capture system audio (the audio output of all running applications) via ScreenCaptureKit. No video frames are saved; only audio is recorded.
